name: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery and development of treatment options for neurodegenerative diseases and endocrine conditions in the United States. It provides Avexitide, an investigational, first-in-class glucagon-like peptide-1, or GLP-1 receptor antagonist, which is in phase 3 clinical trial to treat post-bariatric hypoglycemia and congenital hyperinsulinism.
